policy.aSeries: Prefer a clean official single-cabinet side view. For i installation models, prefer the official white single-cabinet view when available. Preserve Focus and Wide as distinct products and never use a combined Focus/Wide image as primary.
policy.kSeries: Prefer an official single-cabinet horizontal or perspective/three-quarter view. Keep arrays, rigging, rear, detail, transport, and context visuals secondary.
policy.evidence: Runtime candidate hashes were independently recomputed from the working-tree files. Runtime dimensions/format/alpha were independently read with sharp.
